## 44de940bd269

Generator SHA-256: `b7042d2d6f027707b6ac92c81ebbfbaad836b146c7b99cf9bb133397da46d16a`.
Exact canonical rule SHA-256: `e85f8ddb29a2e8c334c1e1794b67d233d324903985673a99c04b5c63db0d91c3`.
Checked eleven case records / five unique inputs: four override requests which
produce the same input, one collision input, and three canonical pairs each
recorded once for rival fit and again for direct canonical execution. The six
canonical records are only **three unique canonical pairs**, not six examples.

**B01 — Reproduced ignored override controls.** At seed 0, sample index 0,
`palette_size=1`, `palette_size=8`, `n_distinct_colors=1`, and
`n_distinct_colors=8` all produce identical grids. All validate successfully.
The ordinary marks contain four distinct colors, `[2,3,4,7]`, even under either
count-1 pin. These pins are declared by the generator but not consumed when
sampling marks. The count-1 pin is the strongest unambiguous contract witness;
count 8 also exposes tension with the generator's smaller mark-count range.
No color-count inference depends solely on whether two same-seed grids differ:
the observed four mark colors directly contradict the explicit count-1 request.
See the four `ignored-*` cases in `checks/audit-44de940bd269.json`.

**B02 — Reproduced rival difference; excluded-domain coverage question.** The
rival mirrors every mark and overwrites occupied reflected cells. It agrees
with all two canonical train pairs and the one canonical test pair. On the
saved 6×9 input with color-5 axis at column 4, opposed color-2/color-3 marks at
(row 1, column 1)/(row 1, column 7), and color 6 at (row 3, column 2), canonical
Racket preserves the opposed marks and adds only the missing reflected color 6.
The overwrite-all rival changes the occupied pair. This is case
`occupied-mirror-preservation`, with both full output grids retained.

The target validator rejects it because both reflected occupied cells are not
blank. Current sampling also excludes this situation. It is therefore a domain
question, **not** a demonstrated mislabeled in-domain sample. Decide whether
occupied-mirror semantics belong in the intended dataset before broadening the
generator. Do not count the successful execution of this rejected input as
in-domain support.

Evidence: `checks/audit-44de940bd269.json`;
requests: `checks/cases-final/audit-44de940bd269-cases.json`.

```bash
python3 run_with_racket.py python3 generators/3ab9aab86992/workspace/reference_probe.py --root . --task 44de940bd269 --cases ../checks/cases-final/audit-44de940bd269-cases.json --canonical --out ../checks/audit-44de940bd269-replay.json
```
